Friction velocity

Source: R/metric-aerodynamics.R
ef_ustar.Rd

Computes the friction velocity \(u_*\) [m s-1] of each pixel from the wind speed at the blending height and the momentum roughness length, with an optional Monin-Obukhov stability correction for momentum at the blending height (neutral when psi_m = 0).

Usage

ef_ustar(u_blend, zom, blending_height, psi_m = 0)

Arguments

u_blend

Numeric. Wind speed at the blending height \(u_b\) [m s-1] (see ef_blending_wind()). Must be finite and >= 0.

zom

Numeric. Momentum roughness length \(z_{om}\) [m] (see ef_zom()). Must be finite, > 0 and lower than blending_height.

blending_height

Numeric. Blending height \(z_b\) [m]. Must be finite and > 0. No default: the METRIC value of 200 m is CANDIDATA.

psi_m

Numeric. Stability correction for momentum at the blending height \(\psi_m(z_b)\) [-]. Must be finite. The default 0 is the neutral case.

Value

A numeric vector of friction velocity \(u_*\) [m s-1], with the common length of the inputs and keeping their dim. Where \(\ln(z_b/z_{om}) - \psi_m \le 0\) (very unstable conditions over a rough surface) the friction velocity is not defined and NA is returned; the calibration of the sensible heat flux flags such pixels with EF_H_USTAR_INVALID. u_blend = 0 gives \(u_* = 0\), which ef_rah() rejects.

Details

$$u_* = \frac{k\, u_b}{\ln(z_b / z_{om}) - \psi_m(z_b)}$$ with the von Karman constant \(k = 0.41\) (FAO-56, chapter 2, Eq. 4). The zero-plane displacement is not used for the pixel (heights are taken above it), as in METRIC implementations.

Missing values propagate. Infinite values and values outside the domain raise an error of class earthflux_domain_error (also earthflux_input_error).

Verification status: CANDIDATA (observed in the water package; the value of \(k\) is VERIFICADA as the FAO-56 value, its use in METRIC is CANDIDATA).

References

Allen, R. G., Tasumi, M., & Trezza, R. (2007). Satellite-based energy balance for mapping evapotranspiration with internalized calibration (METRIC) - Model. Journal of Irrigation and Drainage Engineering, 133(4), 380-394. doi:10.1061/(ASCE)0733-9437(2007)133:4(380)

See also

Other aerodynamics and sensible heat functions: ef_air_density(), ef_blending_wind(), ef_calibrate_h(), ef_dt_coef(), ef_h_control(), ef_rah(), ef_sensible_heat(), ef_ts_datum(), ef_zom()

Examples

# Neutral friction velocity of three pixels (z_b = 200 m)
ef_ustar(u_blend = 5.823611, zom = c(0.06, 0.005, 0.02),
         blending_height = 200)
#> [1] 0.2943492 0.2253244 0.2592391

# With an unstable correction psi_m(z_b) = 4.18
ef_ustar(5.823611, zom = 0.005, blending_height = 200, psi_m = 4.178174)
#> [1] 0.372002
